justification: Brief empty-state polish (frontend display only): (1) an authoritative null field renders 'None' instead of a bare dash (bushfire designation, heritage listing — checked, nothing here); (2) a bushfire prescreen that RAN but found no Bushfire Attack Level shows 'Not bushfire-prone' instead of the misleading 'tick Include satellite' message; (3) the Confidence Summary 'Not available' count is neutral grey, not alarming red, since it is mostly opt-in layers that weren't run.

pre_impl.existing_data: Verified live (14 Stanley, satellite on): environmental.bushfire_designation and heritage_postgis come back value=null/confidence=authoritative; satellite.bushfire returns a present object {category:null,...}/confidence=not_available when the lot is not bushfire-prone.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: An authoritative null was rendering as '—' (looks like missing data) and a ran-but-empty bushfire prescreen was routed to the 'not run' add-on message — both read as failures when they are actually clean results.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new component. The DataField renderer gains a null-authoritative->'None' branch; SectionCard gains a bushfireNotProne check that reuses the existing Unavailable 'clear' tone; one Tailwind colour change.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No data fetching changed. Pure display mapping of values already in the section payload.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: bushfire/heritage looked blank and the bushfire card told the user to tick a box they had already ticked; the summary flashed red on a normal brief. After: 'None'/'Not bushfire-prone' read as checked-clear, and the summary is calm.

functions.name: SectionCard
functions.input: a section id and its DataField payload
functions.output: the section card; a ran-but-not-prone bushfire section shows a 'Not bushfire-prone' clear state
functions.if_none: non-bushfire not_available sections keep the existing describeUnavailable mapping

values: N/A - no regulatory values; display-only mapping of existing fields.
queries: N/A - no database or API query.

break_it.scenario: Satellite analysis is genuinely NOT run, so bushfire value is null
break_it.what_happens: the new bushfire branch could wrongly claim 'not bushfire-prone'
break_it.repro: bushfireNotProne requires value to be a present object; a null value fails the check
break_it.how: value must be a non-null object (the prescreen actually ran); otherwise it falls through to the 'tick Include satellite' message

break_it.scenario: A field is null but NOT authoritative (e.g. derived/estimated could-not-compute)
break_it.how: only authoritative nulls map to 'None'; other nulls keep the existing '—' / empty-state handling

break_it.what_happens: it must not be mislabelled 'not bushfire-prone'
break_it.repro: category != null makes confidence estimated/authoritative -> not the not_available path; bushfireNotProne is false
break_it.how: the branch only fires when category is null AND confidence is not_available

post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief with satellite on for a non-bushfire lot: Environmental bushfire/heritage read 'None'; the Bushfire Risk card reads 'Not bushfire-prone'; the Confidence Summary 'Not available' count is grey, not red.
